blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE : Sofia Hasmik ( Superman & Lois ), Grace Kelly Quigley ( Physical ) and Imogen Waterhouse ( The Buccaneers ) have been cast in writer-director Dejan Mrkic’s debut indie feature, Sissy .

Mrkic is directing from his own original script and will co-produce the film alongside his producing partner, Javier Gonzalez. Gonzalez recently took home the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival for In the Summers , and his previous producing credits include A24’s Funny Pages and the IFC Midnight thriller Swallow . The synopsis reads: “Set over one relentless night, the sibling thriller follows Kim (Hasmik), an aging porn star who takes unexpected custody of her abandoned 11-year-old half-sister, Franki (Quigley). Together, they must navigate a perilous Los Angeles maze, running straight into the chaotic orbit of a notorious Hollywood horror producer.”

blocks.text: Pic is currently in pre-production and the plan is to shoot this year. Lensing the project is cinematographer Hayden Mason, fresh off the Chloë Sevigny-produced documentary Summer Tour , which premiered at the Telluride Film Festival.

Superman & Lois star Hasmik’s recent credits include The Pitt and Netflix comedy Tires . Quigley is best known for her role as Maya Rubin opposite Rose Byrne in three seasons of the Apple TV+ dark comedy Physical . She is coming off the Sundance-winning feature Josephine and will next be seen playing Mila Kunis’ daughter in the upcoming film Nightwatching . Waterhouse stars in her third season of Apple TV+’s The Buccaneers and previously led The CW’s The Outpost , where she also directed three episodes. Hasmik is represented by Anonymous Content, Global Artists Agency, and the law firm Myman Greenspan Fox; Quigley is represented by The Osbrink Agency and Monster Talent Management; and Waterhouse is represented by Margit Polak Management and Verve as well as United Agents in the UK.
